title: Rabbi Yonatan ben Avtolmos
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Rabbi Yonatan ben Avtolmos, a Tanna of a baraita. He is mentioned in Sanhedrin 86 and Niddah 19: Rabbi Yonatan ben Avtolmos says, “From where do we derive the spreading of lesions in garments?” etc. Zevachim 49b reads Rabbi Natan ben Avtolmos. Chullin 24b has Rabbi Yonatan ben Avtolmos saying, “Its inside is stated, to render impure,” etc.

notes.text: Ben Avtolmos is the expansion of the shortened patronym in the connected final clause. The Zevachim reading Natan remains distinct from Yonatan. Sanhedrin 86 and Niddah 19 are printed with semicolons and no side is supplied.
The consulted Zevachim 49b names Natan ben Avtolmos, while Chullin 24b names Yonatan ben Avtolmos. These are occurrence-specific textual readings, not proof that the names identify one person.
